title: The Usage view matches the calls
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castOwner}} wants to see what the cache saved for {{castKey}}.
obstacle: Without counts nobody can tell whether the cache is doing anything.
control: Usage shows Requests, From cache and Saved, and the numbers equal the calls made. How the product computes Saved is not in the release notes: the lab counts output tokens and labels the unit UNVERIFIED.
